payload.title: Rename the Shipped section to In use
payload.description:
"Shipped" is now only the publication's name. The section becomes "In use": products and features you can use today.

Changes:
- Update the label and description in `web/projection.json` (`urls.sections.shipped`) and the CMS section record.
- Rename the newsletter list "Alerts: Shipped" to "Alerts: In use" in the newsletter plugin settings.
- Update Submit's section choices.

The URL key `shipped` stays for now. Moving it to `/in-use/` needs redirects for every item and is a separate decision.

Acceptance:
- No page uses "Shipped" as a section name.
- Existing item URLs still answer 200.
